title: KnowledgeNode
description: A single unit of knowledge in the Kode Brain system.

id.description: Stable, URL-safe flat identifier. Format: domain-type-slug (e.g. auth-login-flow). Never change after first use — edges reference this.

name.description: Human-readable name. Capabilities should be verb phrases.

summary.description: One- or two-sentence explanation of what this is.

project.description: Project slug this node belongs to.

domain.description: Domain slug this node belongs to. Empty for project-level nodes.

confidence.description: How trustworthy the claim is. Separated from provenance (where the claim came from).

provenance.description: Where the claim originated. Separated from confidence (how sure we are). A human statement can be authoritative intent without being verified implementation.

knowledge_role.description: Whether this node describes intended design, observed implementation, both, or is a navigation projection of a canonical source elsewhere.

source_files.description: Source file paths (relative to project root) that support this node.

source_symbols.description: Specific exported symbols (functions, classes, constants) that support this node.

page_path.description: Relative path to the Markdown knowledge page for this node, within docs/brain/.

tags.description: Optional free-form tags for search and filtering.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 date when this node was last updated by any agent or human.

last_reviewed.description: ISO 8601 date when a human last reviewed and confirmed this node.

severity.description: Severity for caveat and incident nodes. Used by --benchmark to compute risk surface score.

change_state.description: Lifecycle state for change records. Status field holds KB quality (active/stale/etc).

decision_state.description: Lifecycle state for decision records. Superseded decisions remain in KB for lineage.

supersedes.description: Decision IDs this decision supersedes. Stored only on the NEW decision. Compiler derives superseded_by on old decisions.

path.description: Relative path from project root to the canonical definition document.

anchor.description: Section anchor within the canonical document (e.g. 'decision-lifecycle').

canonical_source.description: When set, this page is a projection/navigation of an external canonical definition. Normative questions route to canonical_source, not this page.

examples.name: User login flow
examples.summary: The runtime path from a login POST request through credential validation, session creation, and response.

examples.name: Stripe is the current payment provider
examples.summary: The project intends Stripe as its sole payment provider.
